test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Statements:

All sculptures are art.

Some art is ancient.

No ancient object is replaceable.

Conclusions:

I. Some sculptures may not be replaceable.

II. All art is replaceable.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a163260d941247bf6be6932d985db139cc2418f07055dbd805de0c79760ca878.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00e5e312033121d9da5f482c82afba511dcd42c4d49b728171aa02156acda03d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some sculptures may not be replaceable. - **True **(There is no definite relation between sculptures and replaceable, it can be possible but it is not definite. So, Some sculptures may not be replaceable.)

II. All art is replaceable. - False (There is no definite relation between art and replaceable, it can be possible but it is not definite)

Thus, only I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
